name: Combination Discipline — See the Reflected Form

system.description: Prerequisites: Auspex (4), Protean (4). A Mental Challenge reveals a target's Protean beast forms or their single most powerful shapeshifting form from another Discipline; an additional Mental Trait reveals all defined forms; a further Mental Trait reveals potential forms and the emotions tied to the target's shapeshifting. Does not detect Mask of a Thousand Faces (not a true shapechange).
